presets.name: Bigger voice
presets.desc: The same singer a little larger and darker: formants 3 semitones down, pitch and timing untouched
presets.notes: README 4: Live, formant -2 to -4. Zero latency in the in-ears; the TE envelope keeps it from sounding metallic

presets.name: Lighter voice
presets.desc: Formants 3 semitones up on the same notes: female formants sit 15 - 20 % above male ones
presets.notes: README 4: +2.4 to +3.2 st is the male-female formant distance (Peterson & Barney); pitch stays put

presets.name: Child
presets.desc: A small throat on the sung melody: formants 6 semitones up, consonants moved half as much
presets.notes: README 4: Live +6 to +10 with unvoiced 50 % so sibilants do not thin out

presets.name: Chipmunk, same notes
presets.desc: The cartoon-chipmunk timbre without the pitch jump: formants 10 semitones up on the sung notes
presets.notes: Beyond +7 the +24 dB boost clamp already limits how far the valleys rise; unvoiced 50 % keeps the s and t

presets.name: Giant
presets.desc: Pitch 5 semitones and formants 7 semitones down, with some growl and a darker source
presets.notes: README 4: pitch and formant together; the growl is epoch-synchronous in Grain

presets.name: Demon
presets.desc: An octave down, formants 5 semitones down, heavy growl and breath: the horror-film voice
presets.notes: README 4: every throat option at once; mix 100 % so the dry octave above never shows

presets.name: Gender up
presets.desc: Pitch a fifth up and formants 3 semitones up: a lower voice turned higher, both cues moved
presets.notes: README 4: formant alone gives a small man; a real change needs pitch too. Register Low tracks male voices

presets.name: Gender down
presets.desc: Pitch a fifth down and formants 3 semitones down: a higher voice turned lower, both cues moved
presets.notes: README 4: the reverse of gender-up. Grain is the engine that moves the pitch

presets.name: Sung growl
presets.desc: Alternate glottal periods dropped on the predicted epochs: a rough growl on a sung line, zero latency
presets.notes: README 4: growl 30 - 50 %; the modulation runs at f0 / 2, heard as roughness, not tremolo

presets.name: Whisper ghost
presets.desc: Aspiration noise shaped by the shifted envelope on top of a darker voice
presets.notes: README 4: the breath follows the voice's level and the voicing gate; tilt -3 dB/oct for a slacker source

presets.name: Fast lines, live
presets.desc: A slightly bigger voice whose filter keeps up with fast articulation: 20 ms lookahead
presets.notes: README 4: lookahead 20 ms centres the analysis (glide error about 2 dB rms instead of 7) at 20 ms of latency

presets.name: Another singer
presets.desc: A parallel double with formants 2 semitones up: same notes, another throat
presets.notes: README 4: Grain's identity is exact, so only the formants differ; best on a parallel lane

presets.name: Small box
presets.desc: Guitar body made smaller: the envelope 4 semitones up, notes and attack untouched
presets.notes: README 4: a tone effect that leaves pitch and attack alone, polyphonic, zero latency

presets.name: Big box
presets.desc: Guitar body made bigger: the envelope 4 semitones down, a wider, darker box
presets.notes: README 4: Instrument's fixed window and 150 ms envelope smoothing keep chords free of new partials

presets.name: Talk-box sweep
presets.desc: Vowels imposed on the chord: a talk-box without the tube, the vowel on the expression pedal
presets.notes: README 4: put vowel on EXP and sweep a to u; vowel_amt 85 % keeps a little of the guitar's own body

presets.name: Bass giant
presets.desc: Bass body 5 semitones down: a bigger cabinet in the low mids, the noise floor guarded
presets.notes: README 4: the noise-floor guard keeps the shift from lifting hiss

presets.name: Vowel pad
presets.desc: A pad sung on the vowel i: the synth's own envelope replaced by the template
presets.notes: README 4: vowel 50 % is i; vowel_amt 100 % replaces the input's envelope entirely
